apps.name: Sound2U
apps.description: Wereldwijde radio, podcasts, audiobulletins en lokale audio met Save2U, Stats2U en Wake2U.
apps.changelog:
Sound2U v0.4.22

  Debat2U live audio

* Added the Debat2U Live now and Agenda tabs.
* Live now shows only rooms that are currently live according to the official Debat Direct source.
* Added official live audio support for available Tweede Kamer rooms.
* Live cards now show the correct official debate title, room, time and meeting type.
* Added distinctive glass-style live room cards.
* Fixed duplicate live debates and incorrect room information.
* Improved back-swipe navigation between Live now, Agenda and the Sound2U library.
* The Debat2U player now shows the verified official debate subject.
* Removed live DVR rewind and seeking controls to keep Debat2U lightweight and battery-conscious.
* Regular radio, podcast and Sound2U player functionality remains unchanged.

apps.name: VAT24
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog:
VAT24 v1.0.23

- Replaced oversized airport plus/cross symbols with compact blue location pins inspired by modern flight-tracking maps.
- Airport pins stay smaller than aircraft markers and continue to appear progressively as you zoom in.
- Tapping an airport now opens the complete airport details page immediately.
- Back navigation and the edge swipe return to the same radar map centre and zoom level.
- Added updated English and Dutch release notes.

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty changelog v0.5.4 - Provider links now open in Esmarty's own in-app browser by default instead of always handing the URL to Android's default browser. - Added automatic provider-page language detection and on-device translation with ML Kit. - Added website translation targets: System language, Dutch, English and Spanish. - Esmarty first prefers an official provider language variant when one is advertised by the site; otherwise it translates the visible page text. - Added Original / Translate switching plus an explicit Open in browser action. - Login, authentication, cart, checkout and payment flows are handed back to the user's normal browser. - Added an Esmarty settings dialog for in-app browser and translation preferences. - Fixed system theme handling: Esmarty now uses the dark palette when Android dark mode is enabled and the light palette otherwise. - The embedded browser follows system dark mode using WebView algorithmic darkening where supported. - Added explicit day/night system-bar styling. - Updated app version to 0.5.4 (versionCode 10).

apps.name: Weather2U
apps.description: Modern weather app with forecasts, rain radar, official warnings, widgets and smart background alerts.
apps.changelog:
WeatherMe v2.4.7

* Fixed HTTP 406 errors affecting all configured MeteoAlarm country feeds.
* Added a safe retry for temporary warning-provider network failures.
* Increased warning-provider connection and read timeouts for slower public feeds.
* Improved MeteoAlarm region matching using both the selected locality and administrative area.
* Barcelona warning zones such as “Prelitoral de Barcelona” are now detected correctly.
* Added support for Dutch localized Australian state and territory names.
* Warning refresh errors are now shown only on the Warnings tab instead of duplicating them on the main weather screen.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.

apps.name: Data2U
apps.description: Smart mobile data tracking with app usage, SIM/eSIM insights, roaming, forecasts and widgets.
apps.changelog:
Data2U v0.5.3

  Provider database
- Updated Dutch carrier profiles and maximum network speeds.
- Updated current Odido mobile speed profiles.
- Added Lebara's optional 150/75 Mbit/s speed profile.
- Improved Ben, Simpel, Simyo, Youfone and 50+ mobiel provider data.
- Improved provider recognition across the European carrier database.
- More conservative carrier matching prevents incorrect provider detection.
- Unverified carrier speeds or billing rules are no longer assumed.

  Speed2U
- Improved active-network detection.
- Speed2U now remains bound to the actual active Android network.
- Prevented unintended Wi-Fi to mobile-data fallback.
- Improved VPN handling and network isolation.
- Cancelling a speed test no longer produces a false error state.

  Remote carrier database
- Improved remote database reliability.
- Failed update checks no longer block retries for seven days.
- Failed checks can retry after 6 hours.
- Existing ETags are preserved after network failures.
- Remote database updates remain lightweight and foreground-only.

  Stability
- Improved SIM and provider state propagation.
- Dashboard, widgets and warnings now use the same provider context and unit base.
- Improved Smart Pace network handling.
- General stability, consistency and validation improvements.

  Database
- 122 carrier profiles across 7 European countries.
- Improved validation of aliases, IDs and speed profiles.

apps.name: GetMe
apps.description: Eigen Material You appcatalogus en veilige updater voor directe APK-releases.
apps.changelog:
GetMe 1.4.0

- Added a new Update Center with update count and Update all.
- Added app details, categories, favorites and My apps.
- Added installed, update available, new and updated status indicators.
- Added resumable APK downloads with progress, pause, cancel and retry.
- Added optional Wi-Fi-only downloads.
- Added APK package, version, signature and SHA-256 verification.
- Added previous-version history with guarded rollback support.
- Added battery-friendly automatic update checks.
- Added catalog validation and safer cache handling.
- GetMe can now update itself through GetMe.
